error_message: Claims AdMob integration but functionality is unverified — 300+ GDScript files for a single developer requires audit to determine if AdMob is functional or a stub
root_cause: Project claims extensive third-party integrations (AdMob, FMod, Firebase, GDPR, IAP, multiplayer, mod support, battle pass) across 300+ files; each claim needs verification as functional code vs stub/placeholder
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RG-001: Third-party SDK claims must have initialization, lifecycle, and callback implementation — flag as stub if only interface shells exist

error_message: Claims FMod audio integration but may be stub — FMod requires native plugin, bank loading, and event management that must be verified
root_cause: FMod integration claims may be limited to GDScript wrappers without actual FMOD library, bank files, or native plugin configuration
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RG-002: FMod integration must have bank files, native library, and event instance management — not just GDScript stubs

error_message: Claims Firebase integration but backend connectivity unverified — no proof of actual Firebase project, auth, or database calls
root_cause: Firebase integration may consist of GDScript class skeletons without actual REST/gRPC calls, auth tokens, or real Firebase project ID
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RG-003: Firebase integration must include project ID, API key configuration, and actual network calls — not just class definitions

error_message: Claims GDPR compliance but may be just a toggle without actual consent management or data handling
root_cause: GDPR implementation may be a simple boolean flag without actual consent flow, data export, data deletion, or cookie/policy management
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RG-004: GDPR compliance must include consent collection, data export, data deletion, and consent withdrawal — not just a toggle flag

error_message: Claims IAP (In-App Purchases) but implementation unverified — requires platform-specific store integration
root_ause: IAP may be GDScript stubs without actual Google Play Billing, Apple StoreKit, or payment processing
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RG-005: IAP implementation must include platform billing SDK, product ID registration, purchase flow, and receipt verification

error_message: Claims multiplayer support but may lack server code, networking protocol, or match management
root_cause: Multiplayer claim may consist of ENet/WebSocket references without actual server architecture, room management, or state synchronization
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RG-006: Multiplayer must have server/host code, peer management, state sync, and disconnect handling — not just RPC stubs

error_message: Claims mod support but may lack actual mod loading, API, or sandboxing
root_cause: Mod support may be mentioned in docs/README without actual mod loading code, PCK loading, scripting API, or mod directory scanning
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RG-007: Mod support must include mod loading (PCK/zip), mod API surface, directory scanning, and isolation — not just documentation claims

error_message: Claims battle pass system but may be just UI mockups without progression logic
root_cause: Battle pass may have UI scenes and data structures without actual XP tracking, season management, reward distribution, or expiry logic
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RG-008: Battle pass must include season lifecycle, XP tracking, tier unlock logic, and reward claiming — not just UI

error_message: 300+ GDScript files for a solo developer is extraordinary — possible AI-generated bloat or feature inflation without quality control
root_cause: 1724 total files including 300+ GDScript files is far beyond typical solo Godot project scope; may indicate AI-generated stubs, copy-paste expansion, or feature claims without implementation
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RG-009: Audit projects with 200+ source files for functional vs stub ratio — flag files with empty _ready() or pass-only bodies

error_message: 7 Python tooling scripts alongside GDScript — purpose and necessity unclear, may include unused or broken tooling
root_cause: Python scripts may be build tools, asset processors, or code generators; their relationship to the Godot project and actual usage needs verification
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RG-010: Python tooling alongside Godot must be documented with purpose, inputs, and outputs — flag undocumented scripts
